source_rules: SAVEONSUB pricing must be independently approved for SAVEONSUB.
AIPS prices, analyses, floor calculations, or price precedence are research inputs only and cannot authorize a SAVEONSUB selling price.
A formula or competitor survey is not equivalent to an approved public price.
Every future active price must reference a stable plan ID, amount, effective date, and dated authority reference.
commerce_effect: public prices and server quotes remain disabled until active_prices is populated from current SAVEONSUB authority
